 Options Newsman wrote a column · Nov 19 17:57 QQQ Gains Premarket as Put/Call Ratio Falls Close to 1, Despite Fed Rate-Hike Signals | Options Market Statistics
 Pre-Market Outlook $Invesco QQQ Trust(QQQ.US)$ rises 1.8% pre-market, $SPDR S&P 500 ETF(SPY.US)$ rises 1.12% pre-market. Developments around Nasdaq-100 heavyweights intensified as Anthropic priced its major IPO at $83 a share, while Nvidia’s results and guidance continued to point to strong AI demand. At the same time, Fed minutes and official comments signaled that further rate hikes could still come in the coming months. Options market data show that QQQ had a Put/Call volume ratio that fell to 1.01 on the last trading day, with implied volatility (IV) at 33.21%. $Micron Technology(MU.US)$ rises 3.94% pre-market, Micron Sees Tighter Memory Supply Through 2028 on Strong AI Demand. Options market data show that its Put/Call volume ratio fell to 0.65 on the last trading day, with implied volatility (IV) at 80.59%. The highest-volume contract expiring 2026-11-20 is the $800 strike call options, down 77.25% on last session. $NVIDIA(NVDA.US)$ rises 1.68% pre-market, Nvidia Reports Third-Quarter Results, Issues $130 Billion Revenue Outlook, and Starts CEO Search. Options market data show that its Put/Call volume ratio fell to 0.57 on the last trading day, with implied volatility (IV) at 55.79%. The highest-volume contract expiring 2026-11-20 is the $160 strike call options, down 88.24% on last session. Last Session Options Market Recap Index Options EST November 18, U.S. index options volume declined, totaling 7.33M contracts. The put/call ratio went up to 1.15. For $S&P 500 Index (.SPX.US)$ options expiring on next trading session, volume distribution: put peak at 7,325, call peak at 7,450. Single Stocks Options $Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.US)$ closed up 5.31%, with 838.60K option contracts traded; the put/call ratio declined to 0.81. OpenAI said its models helped AMD achieve roughly a year of chip development progress in less than five months, with some results included in a taped-out design. $Strategy (MSTR.US)$ closed down 6.40%, with 528.80K option contracts traded; the put/call ratio declined to 0.80. Monness Crespi Hardt downgrades Strategy to sell from neutral. Top 10 Stocks With Highest Daily Options Volume Among the top 10 stocks by options volume, $Apple (AAPL.US)$ has the highest put/call trading volume ratio at 0.94. Apple director Arthur D. Levinson sold 90,000 common shares on Nov. 16 at an average price of $352.95 for $31.77 million. The highest put/call open interest ratio is $Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.US)$ at 1.06. Top 10 Stocks With Highest Implied Volatility $Sellas Life Sciences (SLS.US)$ has the highest implied volatility at 138.74%, down 4.37% from the previous session. Sellas Life Sciences priced an underwritten public offering of 11,538,462 shares at $13 per share, with expected gross proceeds of $150.0 million. $AST SpaceMobile (ASTS.US)$ implied volatility rose the most, reaching 121.63%, up 4.58% from the previous session.
